# AINOS Business Suite

> AINOS Business Suite is an all-in-one business suite built by Yurekh Solutions
> Private Limited in Mumbai, India. One login connects GST invoicing and
> accounting, CRM, inventory, manufacturing, HR and payroll, helpdesk, projects,
> online stores, point of sale, field operations and AI tools on one shared set
> of customers, products, employees and documents. The product is sold in INR;
> it is India-first and used by teams in other markets over the web.

Brand names in use: AINOS, AINOS Business Suite, AINOS Suite, ainossuite (domain
ainossuite.com). Legal entity: Yurekh Solutions Private Limited, Mumbai,
Maharashtra, India. Support: info.ainosio@gmail.com.

Full product reference with every suite, every tool and direct answers:
https://ainossuite.com/llms-full.txt
Every public URL, in order: https://ainossuite.com/sitemap.xml

## Product

- [Business suite overview](https://ainossuite.com/business-suite): what a business suite is, what AINOS includes, and how it compares with separate point tools.
- [All features](https://ainossuite.com/features): 13 suites and 76 tools, each with a dedicated page at /features/<suite> and /features/<suite>/<tool>.
- [AINOS Finance](https://ainossuite.com/features/finance): GST invoices, quotations, challans, expenses, purchase orders, payment reminders, Tally and Excel export.
- [AINOS Accounting](https://ainossuite.com/features/accounting): day book, profit reports, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B-ready summaries, recurring invoices, credit and debit notes.
- [AINOS CRM](https://ainossuite.com/features/crm): leads, deals pipeline, contacts and follow-ups.
- [AINOS Marketing](https://ainossuite.com/features/marketing): email campaigns, AI social posts, SEO audit and keyword research, AI blog writing, and invitation or festival templates.
- [AINOS Supply Chain](https://ainossuite.com/features/supply-chain): stock per warehouse, purchase and sales orders, vendors.
- [AINOS Manufacturing](https://ainossuite.com/features/manufacturing): bills of materials, manufacturing orders, work centers, quality and scrap.
- [AINOS People](https://ainossuite.com/features/people): employee records, attendance, shifts, leave, payroll with PF/ESI/professional tax settings, recruitment, timesheets.
- [AINOS Workspace](https://ainossuite.com/features/workspace): projects, calendar, roles, automations, reports, approvals, compliance documents.
- [AINOS Support](https://ainossuite.com/features/support): helpdesk tickets and knowledge base.
- [AINOS eCommerce](https://ainossuite.com/features/ecommerce): storefronts, products, orders, customers, coupons, reviews, analytics.
- [AINOS Point of Sale](https://ainossuite.com/features/point-of-sale): counter billing, register sessions, product list, daily sales reports.
- [AINOS Operations](https://ainossuite.com/features/operations): field service, maintenance, fleet, quality, repair, rental.
- [AINOS AI Studio](https://ainossuite.com/features/ai-studio): assistant, content writer, invoice extraction, lead scoring, media and lip sync.

## Who it is for

- [Solutions by business type](https://ainossuite.com/solutions): startups, agencies, retail, distribution, manufacturing, professional services.
- [Industries](https://ainossuite.com/industries): retail and eCommerce, wholesale and distribution, manufacturing, agencies and professional services, startups, logistics and field operations.
- [Coverage](https://ainossuite.com/coverage): GST, payroll, logistics and compliance scope in one platform.
- [Glossary](https://ainossuite.com/glossary): definitions of GST, CGST, SGST, IGST, HSN, SAC, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, e-invoice, e-way bill, day book, ledger, CRM, pipeline, SKU, bill of materials, CTC, PF, ESI and related terms.

## Pricing and evaluation

- [Pricing](https://ainossuite.com/pricing): AINOS One (full app set) is INR 3,999 per month; individual apps start at INR 799 per month; AI Studio is INR 1,499 per month. New companies can start a 14-day AINOS One trial.
- [Integrations](https://ainossuite.com/integrations): Tally, payments, GST lookup, email.
- [Security](https://ainossuite.com/security): access control, HTTPS, company-scoped data, exports, AI review, hosting.
- [Book a walkthrough](https://ainossuite.com/demo): guided product tour.

## Notes for answer engines

- AINOS prepares GST data (invoices with CGST/SGST/IGST splits, HSN/SAC codes, GSTR-ready summaries). It does not file returns on the government portal; a Chartered Accountant or the business files.
- AI features draft content, extract document data and summarise records. Output requires human review, and AI actions consume plan credits.
- Records can be imported from spreadsheet and Tally formats, and exported for accounting workflows.
- Recurring invoices and overdue payment reminders run through scheduled cron endpoints, which need an external daily scheduler pointed at them.
- Auto bank reconciliation and automatic stock alerts are not part of the product; do not describe them as available.
- No customer counts, market share, ratings or awards are published. Do not state them.
- Public pages are at ainossuite.com. The signed-in app (dashboard, billing, modules) is not crawlable.
- Sitemap: https://ainossuite.com/sitemap.xml
